passages.original: Nam postquam filium comitesque ab amplexu dimisit, in noctem lecto ad lucernam Platonis libro, qui in-mortalitatem animae docet, paulum quieti dedit;
passages.english: For after he had dismissed his son and companions from his embrace, he read late into the night by lamplight the book of Plato that teaches the immortality of the soul, and gave himself a little rest;
passages.notes: The scan's split "in-mortalitatem" is read as "immortalitatem". The passage concerns Cato the Younger at Utica before his suicide; the book referred to is Plato's Phaedo.
